The visitors will find it tough to chase down this huge total against the talented Kiwi bowlers. A good start might help their case to make it a fierce contest. Let's see what we have in store in the 2nd innings of the first ODI match between these two teams. Join us in a while for the second innings.

New Zealand will be extremely happy with their performance after they lost Guptill and Williamson very early. Latham seemed to be running out of partners at a moment but he found wise company in Munro. The former stuck it out in the middle and showed his class by scoring his career best score of 137. Munro came in at a time when the hosts needed someone to support Latham, and he just did what was required for the team as he also reached to his career best score. The home side has successfully posted the joint highest score on this ground.
